paper.title: Light-Regulated Gene Expression Patterns During Conidial Formation in Aspergillus oryzae
paper.authors: Lin S, Yang J, Wang A, Fu Q, Huang S, Liu M.
paper.association_evidence: Data availability: 'Raw data were uploaded to the SRA library (accession number: PRJNA909033, Table S5).'

study_summary.objective: Find which genes of the koji mold A. oryzae respond to the colour of light, focusing on genes for conidia formation and light sensing.
study_summary.experimental_design: Strain GDMCC 3.31 grew 72 h at 30 C on PDA plates covered with cellophane under blue (475 nm), green (520 nm) or red (630 nm) LED light at 80 umol m-2 s-1, or in darkness as control; 3 replicates each, then qRT-PCR on light doses.
study_summary.main_finding: Red, green and blue light changed 501, 424 and 742 genes compared with darkness (406 only with blue); six genes (tcsA, catA, gld1, Aowc-1, abaA, AofphA) were light-regulated, and abaA depended on both colour and dose.

pda_cellophane_72h.note: potato infusion is an undefined component
BioSample strain '3.042'; the paper calls the strain GDMCC 3.31

light_treated.note: light exposure relative to the darkness control

notes: The BioSamples carry strain '3.042' with culture collection GDMCC:3.31. PRJNA801076 uses the same '3.042' strain label; whether both are the same stock is not established here.
The paper also ran qRT-PCR with a low light dose (30 min after 40 h in darkness); those samples are not part of this RNA-seq BioProject.
